positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerification
positions.frame: what establishes the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz as verified?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the calibration value itself; src-2 supplies the verification act (against June reference plates, holding across the observing band) that grounds that assertion; src-3 is the session's declarative record consolidating both claims into a single instrument/calibration entry. Read together, the three expressions describe one status claim from assertion through verification to record — no tension, just the layering of claim, warrant, and记录.
